instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the UI applying a premium 'Soft Dark' B2B SaaS aesthetic. Prioritize data legibility, generous whitespace, and strict hierarchy. Do not alter functional structure, only appearance. Ensure data-testid attributes are present on all interactive elements.

Card.description: Base container for widgets and groups.
Card.base_classes: bg-[#222B40] border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-md p-6 text-slate-200 transition-all duration-200
Card.guideline: Avoid pure black shadows. Use inner borders for definition. Text inside should be #94A3B8 for labels, #F8FAFC for values.

Button.primary: bg-[#9DBC85] hover:bg-[#5F7552] text-slate-900 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(157,188,133,0.15)]
Button.secondary: bg-[#2D3850] hover:bg-[#3b4763] text-slate-200 border border-white/10 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors
Button.ghost: bg-transparent hover:bg-white/5 text-slate-300 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors
Button.danger: bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors

Tabs.container: flex space-x-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide w-full mask-image-linear-right
Tabs.pill_base: whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium transition-colors border border-transparent cursor-pointer

Input_Select.base: bg-[#181F30] border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#9DBC85]/50 focus:border-[#9DBC85] transition-all placeholder:text-slate-500
Input_Select.label: text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block

Modal.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-[#181F30]/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4
Modal.content: bg-[#222B40] border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto p-6
Modal.header: text-xl font-bold text-slate-100 mb-4 border-b border-white/10 pb-4

AdminDashboard.header: Sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#181F30]/80 border-b border-white/10 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center
AdminDashboard.logo_treatment: As the logo is black on white, apply `filter: invert(1)` or wrap it in a clean `bg-slate-100 rounded-md p-1` container to make it visible on dark backgrounds.
AdminDashboard.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 mt-6
AdminDashboard.kpi_card: bg-[#222B40] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between. Add a 2px left border `border-l-[#9DBC85]` for main metrics, `border-l-[#FCD34D]` for requests.
AdminDashboard.kpi_value: text-3xl font-bold text-slate-100 font-['Cabinet_Grotesk'] tracking-tight tabular-nums

TabelaWyceny.container: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#222B40] shadow-sm
TabelaWyceny.thead: text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#2D3850]/50 sticky top-0 z-20
TabelaWyceny.th: px-4 py-3 border-b border-white/10 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap
TabelaWyceny.negotiation_mode: When active, wrap the table or add a top banner with `bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/30 text-orange-400 p-4 rounded-xl`. Update input borders to orange focus states.

TabelaGodzin.container: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#222B40]
TabelaGodzin.sticky_left_cols: sticky left-0 z-10 bg-[#222B40] border-r border-white/10 shadow-[4px_0_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)]
TabelaGodzin.cells: w-10 h-10 text-center border-r border-b border-white/5 font-mono text-sm

tailwind_index_css_updates.global_apply:
body { @apply bg-[#181F30] text-slate-200 font-['IBM_Plex_Sans']; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { @apply font-['Cabinet_Grotesk'] tracking-tight; }
